data.title: Elizabeth Ruff gave Lulu and Georgia 1 star. Check out the full review...
data.content:
I ordered a desk amd two nightstands.

I got an email that all had arrived. 

The nightstands arrived on two separate days.

The desk delivery, however, was a nightmare. Although the email said “delivered” the desk was not.

I sent countless emails, only to be at first, responded to by a computer driven non personal response.

Then a person responded but with a very impersonal, what felt like a rehearsed response that did it really address my issue.

It took many emails, all very impersonal from your side, to finally get the desk.

I’m a designer. When things go wrong it makes me look incompetent to my client. When I mess up- I take responsibility. Your company, however, is impersonal and does not even bother to call me even after it has taken so long for the desk to “appear”

I feel that your costumer service department is severely lacking. One would think, that you would take better care of your designers. Especially becuse we come back time after time if you treat us right. I don’t do a few bedrooms for my own home, I do hundreds a year. Investing a little effort in taking care of me so that I can take care of my clients feels like good business practice to me. The desk was finally delivered. However, it should not have been so much work on my part and so little effort on yours.
